error.message:
Expected upstream_failure: R odbc reports completion and affected rows before parameters have been bound. Reference: https://github.com/r-dbi/odbc/blob/v1.4.2/src/result.cpp. Reproducer: repros/r-contract.R.
Reported FAILED: dbGetRowsAffected(res) (`actual`) not identical to NA_integer_ (`expected`).

  `actual`:  0
`expected`: NA
dbHasCompleted(res) is not FALSE

`actual`:   TRUE 
`expected`: FALSE
